scheme_name: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
other_conditions: Applicant must obtain permission for migration from the Protector of Emigrants (POE) office under the Migrant Act, 1983
The recruiting agency must be registered under the Overseas Act or possess a valid permit from the POE office
The beneficiary’s passport must have a minimum validity of six months, including a valid visa, at the time of reimbursement
The assistance amount is payable only once to the beneficiary
If any false information is found during scrutiny, the beneficiary must repay the assistance amount with interest
The benefit is payable only if the beneficiary is employed abroad in building and other construction works
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to Rs.5,000 for visa expenses for construction workers from Rajasthan who have secured overseas employment.
documents_required: Proof of employment in a foreign country
Registration proof with the Construction Workers Welfare Board (Rajasthan)
Passport with minimum six months validity and valid visa
